lines.zh: 铁皮关节一格一格地转
lines.en: My joints turn one notch at a time.

lines.zh: 我走路时里面有东西在响
lines.en: Something rattles inside as I walk.
My right leg drags half a beat behind.
Dust falls with every step.
The fabric is torn; the frame shows.
I move down the corridor step by step.
A small light flickers in my eye.
I do not run; I do not need to.
My feet land with a dull sound.
I stop at the corner and take long to turn.

lines.zh: 三十点的力道，走得很稳
lines.en: Thirty points of force, walking quite steadily.

lines.zh: 我身后留下一串铁锈味
lines.en: A trail of rust smell follows me.
My head tilts, my jaw hanging open.
The thing inside wants out.
I stand still, like a display piece.
Wires still hum inside my back.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，关节卡了一下
lines.en: I raise a hand; a joint catches.
These walls are old.
I listen for anyone coming near.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地看了很久
lines.en: I stare motionless for a long while.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音不是我的
lines.en: The sound in my throat is not mine.

lines.zh: 胸腔里的弹簧松了一格
lines.en: A spring inside my chest slips a notch.
I turn my head slowly; the neck creaks.
You should not have come in.
I know what a living one looks like.
I tilt my head and measure the distance.
I watch you from the dark.

lines.zh: 你后退的声音我听得见
lines.en: I hear you backing away.
We are somewhat alike, are we not?
You still carry warmth.

lines.zh: 破损的面罩后面，我在笑。
lines.en: Behind this cracked mask, I'm smiling.
Do not pretend you did not see me.

lines.zh: 铁皮凹了，里面的东西在叫
lines.en: The shell dents; the thing inside cries out.
I rock, then stand.
Another tear in the fabric.
That slowed me for an instant.
I tilt my head as if enduring.
The thing inside presses outward.
One wire is severed.
I barely feel pain.
But I know I ought to.
You struck accurately.
I do not eat.
What are you doing with that?

lines.zh: 里面的东西饿了，不是我
lines.en: The thing inside is hungry; not I.
Put it down, then walk away.
I do not need your kindness.

lines.zh: 我伸手，但手指不太听话
lines.en: I reach, but my fingers do not obey.
These are useless to the dead.
Keep it; I will not take it.
The shell clangs loudly.
The blow sets me askew.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是一整套骨架
lines.en: You hit a full frame of bone and steel.
I raise a hand half a beat late.
We are very close. Too close.
I steady and face you again.

lines.zh: 铁和铁碰在一起，会响很久
lines.en: Iron on iron rings a long time.
I give half a step, as if hesitating.
Do not touch my shell.

lines.zh: 这具身体做不了那种事
lines.en: This body cannot do such things.

lines.zh: 我只是个壳，里面装过一个人
lines.en: I am a shell that once held a man.
A companion? I have only one.

lines.zh: 我早就和别的东西绑在一起了
lines.en: I am bound to something else already.

lines.zh: 弹簧在我关节里咔咔作响。
lines.en: Springs click in my joints.
I have no warmth.
I tilt my head and give no answer.

lines.zh: 这种念头让我里面的东西躁动
lines.en: That thought stirs the thing inside.

lines.zh: 你走吧，趁我还记得自己是谁
lines.en: Leave while I still remember who I was.
Let us not pretend to be alive.

lines.zh: 我的手指不太会捡东西
lines.en: My fingers are poor at picking things up.

lines.zh: 我把它捏起来，看了很久
lines.en: I pinch it up and look at it a long time.
This belonged to someone once.
I tuck it inside my chest.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我都要
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground, I claim.

lines.zh: 我捏碎了它，不是故意的
lines.en: I crushed it by accident.
I hold it up to my eye.
This weight reminds me of a wrench.

lines.zh: 我不跑，所以我一定追到你
lines.en: I do not run, so I will still find you.
This building has one door.

lines.zh: 我右腿拖着，慢半拍，可我不停。
lines.en: My right leg drags half a beat, but I do not stop.
The light has found you.
Something in my bones is laughing.
Do not hide; the walls are thin.

lines.zh: 这声音是我发出来的吗
lines.en: Was that sound mine?
I push my head forward.
What I want is not food.
Your breathing is far too obvious.
It will not hurt very much.
Come here so I can see you clearly.
Step by step, unhurried.
You went into the closet.
I wait outside the door.
You have taken three breaths.
I do not need light to see.
Your steps leave prints in the dust.
I have walked this whole floor.
How many rooms do you have left?
I stand in the middle of the corridor.
The doorknob turns; it is my hand.
I do not need to breathe.
You are counting the distance.
Only you and I are here.
I drift closer to the doorway.
My shadow arrives first.
I will not break the door; I will wait.
You are making noise in there.

lines.zh: 我沿着走廊，一步一步靠近。
lines.en: I come down the hall, one step at a time.
My hand slams the door frame.
Not fast, but heavy enough.
I catch your shoulder.
Iron fingers dig in.
My arm rises very slowly.
Your armor caught one blow.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿是金属的
lines.en: I bite down; my teeth are metal.
Do not think I tire.

lines.zh: 这一下把我自己的手也弄弯了
lines.en: That bent my own hand.
I lower and come from above.

lines.zh: 三十点的力道，一下就好
lines.en: Thirty points of force; one is enough.
My shell crashes into you.
I shove you back three steps.
The sound comes from my chest cavity.
You are still standing; that surprises me.
Again.
I have your wrist.
A man once wore this suit.
I let go. Strange.
That one took everything.
I open my eyes in the dark.
A rack falls; I stand up.
This room smells of old blood.

lines.zh: 我的关节一格一格地归位
lines.en: My joints lock into place one by one.
One stage light still burns.
I hear the wires.
I know this place.
I lift my head, slowly.
Dust falls from my shoulders.
The paintings on the wall are unchanged.
Someone walks upstairs.
I push the half-open door.
Old cloth burns away fast.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿反着弯了
lines.en: My leg bends the wrong way.
Water pours into my eye sockets.
The blast half takes me apart.
Something lodges in my chest cavity.

lines.zh: 那力量把里面的东西搅醒了
lines.en: That force wakes what is inside.
I do not eat, but I can run dry.

lines.zh: 电走遍全身，我抽了一下
lines.en: Current runs through me and I jerk.
No floor here for me to stand on.
